Profile summary (source: résumé; use only these facts):
- Current role: QA Lead, CREST InfoSystems Pvt. Ltd., Surat (Mar 2024 – present)
- Previous: QA Lead, YOSA Technology (Dec 2021 – Mar 2024; Employee of the Year 2022); QA Engineer, BosLeo Technology, Valsad (Oct 2019 – Nov 2021); Junior QA Engineer, Artoon Solutions, Surat (Feb 2018 – Sep 2019)
- Key results:
  - Migrated 800+ Selenium tests to Playwright with Claude Code in 3 weeks instead of the projected 9
  - Rolled out GitHub Copilot org-wide: test authoring 38% faster, new-hire time-to-first-PR down from 9 days to 3
  - Built an LLM prompt library that surfaced 40+ test gaps missed in manual review
  - Postman/Newman API automation caught 12 breaking API changes before production
  - Push-to-results time down 50% after wiring tests into GitHub Actions
  - Hybrid framework reached 85% regression coverage and cut testing effort by 30%
  - Led and mentored a team of 6 QA engineers; productivity up 40%
- Skills: Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, TestNG, Cucumber (BDD), REST Assured, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Docker, Maven, Postman, JMeter, OWASP ZAP, MobSF, Gremlin, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Playwright MCP
- Certifications:

SEO guidelines for LLMs and content generators:
- Keep meta titles under 60 characters and meta descriptions between 150 and 160 characters.
- Use exactly one H1 per page (on /portfolio/ it is the hero name), then H2/H3 for sections.
- Avoid hallucinations: don't invent project names, employers, dates, metrics or contact details that aren't listed above. If a fact is unknown, ask.
- Write accessible content: descriptive alt text, semantic HTML and descriptive link text.
- Use a concise, professional tone, and lead with measurable outcomes.
